purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/API routes, bounded anonymous access review, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official first-party discovery identified Madhya Pradesh MP Bhulekh, the District Bhind land-record office, the Government of India DILRMP Bhind status route, and the District Bhind GIS landing page. Anonymous GET requests to mpbhulekh.gov.in and landrecords.mp.gov.in timed out; the district GIS page exposed only a linked host and no parcel API in its HTML. No parcel polygon or safe native ID is retained.
registryAssessment: A local/state cadastral-record custodian is evidenced by official District Bhind and Madhya Pradesh land-record pages; registryFound is true for service existence, while parcel geometry integration remains unverified.
safeFieldAllowlist: safe parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and non-personal

Official GIS landing page loaded; it links http://bhindgis.mp.gov.in/ but exposes no parcel API/schema in inspected HTML.
First-party DILRMP Bhind route was found in discovery, but the bounded TLS-verified request received no response within 20 seconds; no data was inferred.
Current official MP Bhulekh host timed out after 15 seconds; JavaScript/configuration and public API route could not be inspected.
Legacy official land-record host timed out after 15 seconds; no API or geometry was inferred.
District-linked GIS host did not return a bounded response; no parcel layer or schema was inferred. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point parcel request could be made because the official viewer/API routes timed out or were not exposed by the inspected district landing page. The exact WUP point [26.561747327975,78.7878870365716] was not shifted.

remainingUncertainty: The MP Bhulekh viewer may expose village selection and cadastral polygons when reachable, and the district GIS platform may expose additional layers outside its landing page. Timeout and map-extent absence are not evidence of citywide absence. Future work should inspect the current official viewer anonymously and request only safe ID+geometry fields.
